label: Declaration d'interets and declaration de situation patrimoniale - filed, publication pending
detail: As a member of government appointed in February 2026, Berger filed declarations with the HATVP. As of the research date, the HATVP nominative page shows declarations 'deposee - publication a venir' (filed - publication forthcoming) and 'publication en prefecture a venir'. No financial figures are publicly available yet. Earlier deputy-mandate declarations referenced amendments dated 12 August 2025 (interests) and 29 October 2025 (assets); detailed figures not published in accessible sources.
